column1: UNCTAD Stages of Processing category 1 over total exports — the same definition used for Africa and the GCC elsewhere in this dataset. Reporter-declared exports (XPRT-TRD-VL). US$ thousand.
These shares are computed on UNCTAD Stages of Processing, not on the SITC commodity groups (food, agricultural raw materials, fuels,
ores and metals). The two measures give different answers for the same region — Latin America is 30 per cent on Stages of Processing
and 24 per cent on the narrow SITC definition — so the comparison only holds if every region in it is measured the same way.
A comparison built on the SITC commodity groups would rank these regions differently; warnings derived from that
Block shares are pooled: the sum of raw-material exports over the block divided by the sum of total exports over the block.
Middle East & North Africa overlaps with Africa (it contains the Maghreb and Egypt) and with the GCC, so it should not be cited
alongside them as an independent region.
